name: Duo Doors
how: Stand on plates to hold doors open for each other, boost a friend onto high ledges, pull levers, and get everyone to the exit. Five short levels.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD and Space, or on-screen buttons. Tap to send your buddy somewhere
uses: The host's browser works out which plates are pressed and which doors are open; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Alone? A buddy bot follows you, holds plates for you and goes where you tap.
The fastest run through all five levels.
Everyone moves, stacks and opens doors together.
ideas: Add a level where one player carries a key
Add spikes that only open when a plate is held
Turn the levels into a haunted house
